Question 9
?

Consider the arc of the curve x=2y−y3 that lies in the first quadrant between its y-intercepts. What integral gives the surface area generated when this arc is rotated 2π radians about the x-axis?

a
2π∫02(2y−y3)9y4−12y2+5dy
b
2π∫02y29y4−12y2+5dy
c
2π∫022y−y31+2y−y3dy
d
2π∫02y9y4−12y2+5dy
e
2π∫02y1+2y−y3dy
